==Biography==
On October 14, 2014, it was announced that Zuna would be playing Heroes of the Storm for [[Cloud9]] at BlizzCon.<ref>http://cloud9.gg/news/2014/10//cloud9-enters-the-storm-with-new-heroes-of-the-storm-team</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Before being announced as the new AD Carry for [[Team FeaR]], he was actually being tried out as their new Top Laner.
* Tried out for the position of Top Laner for [[Team Dignitas]] after [[IWillDominate]]'s suspension, but the role was eventually filled by [[KiWiKiD]].
* Switched to AD Carry for [[CLG Black]] after [[Hoodstomp]]'s retirement.
* Stated that he prefers to play AD over any other role in an [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bYZNAO0nRn8 interview] by Megumixbear at [[IPL 5]]
* His brother is [[Kenma]], XDG Gaming's coach.
* Sometimes, during intense teamfights, Zuna shouts commands to his teammates that can be heard throughout the venue.
* Because of his bad vision, he looks like he's staring down away from the monitor when the LCS cameras cut to a shot of him.
